source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At fixed revision0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, nsMsgAccountManager::Init starts Panorama only with MOZ_PANORAMA and the startup preference enabled. It checks rv from do_GetService, calls databaseCore->Startup() without assigning its nsresult, then checks the unchanged rv again. That second check cannot detect a failure returned by Startup. DatabaseCore::Startup itself returns on EnsureConnection failure. This is a bounded current static status-flow concern; no startup failure or user-visible effect was reproduced. It is separate from the historical Promise-rejection continuation issue.
title: The Panorama account-manager caller checks the lookup result after Startup
